title: ヤマニンゼファー登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inspired by a runner called the Mile Emperor, Yamanin Zephyr longs to become the wind—strong, free, and above all, fast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Driven by that ideal, she devotes herself to excessively rigorous training ahead of her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing that past injuries have stolen opportunities from her, I'm determined to prevent history from repeating itself while guiding her towards her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, I promise to be the wind at her back, and our training session ends with Yamanin Zephyr placing her trust in me.
